basic_info.description: 3770 24th Street is a 27 unit building with 28 car parking located in the heart of Noe Valley between Church and Chattanooga Streets. The property is being sold for the 1st time the by the family who originally built it in 1972. The unit mix consists of 4(four) studios, seventeen(17) 1-bedrooms, and six(6) 2-bedroom units. The main garage houses 26 parking spaces. There is a separate garage with two-car side-by-side parking. Three units and the two-car garage will be delivered vacant.   The heaters and ovens are electric throughout. The rear units have North + East facing views of The City skyline and the Mission District. The location is hard to beat, with walking access to all the shops and restaurants of 24th Street. The J-Church Muni train stops at the corner providing easy access to downtown and Market St. Priced at 10 GRM and 5.9% cap rate, 3770 24th Street offers a rare opportunity to own a modern building, with scale and parking in Noe Valley.
